claim: Test whether model-owned task decomposition and observation-grounded semantic working state break the observed successful-inspection/no-progress loop on the same Lighthouse task. Empty prior capsules identify an unwired interface, not a proven cause of quality failure.
method_delta: Only decision_format becomes task_state_v1: the same normal Brain decision emits plan, evidence, reasoning, action. The runtime validates exact quotes from prior real tool outputs, applies extractive facts via the existing StateReducer, and explicitly selects those predicates for the next native request capsule. The latest model plan and explicitly unverified interpretation persist outside the trimmable journal. Raw decisions, results and rejections remain audited. No additional planner/choice request, hard successful-action novelty mask, automatic patch, answer hint, or task-specific source ranking.
grounding: At most two quotes of 1..200 characters per decision and 1..4 model-generated subgoals of 1..160 characters. Citation action_index must exist and precede the decision; quotes must exactly occur in actual submitted tool output. Invalid state updates reject the proposed action with explicit invalid_task_evidence and consume a slot. Historical quotes never assert current file content after a mutation. Plans and interpretations are not promoted to verified facts. Semantic commit success denotes valid extraction, not tool success or task correctness; serial Brain commits are not genuine branches.
fixed_conditions: Same unmerged Qwen2.5-Coder-14B revision aedcc2d42b622764e023cf882b6652e646b95671, seed17, temperature0, BF16, same GPU type, 12 actions including rejections, 512 total output tokens per decision including plan/evidence, 16384 context limit, 8192 journal budget. Retain canonical failure_aware_v3, raw/bounded reads, counted edit feedback, native chat, deduplicate_v1, matching_files_v1 directory search, regex_v1 syntax, task image and original official evaluator. No model/download/training/budget change.
offline_evidence: CPU closed-trace repro: all12 original semantic capsules empty despite6 nonempty outputs. Nine generic regressions cover exact citations, atomic rejection, deduplication, historical evidence, persistence after journal trimming, unchanged action masks/budgets, and the actual repair path with real read/edit tools plus fixture verification. Closed-trace CPU replay uses synthetic generic plan/first-line citations only as a wiring test: six grounded facts, ten nonempty next-input capsules, exact pinned-tokenizer capsule roundtrips, maximum3628 input tokens. Synthetic replay decisions are not model behavior and are never fed to the quality episode.
quality_gate: Original official resolved=true only. A plan, a grounded quote, an edit, a passing developer test, or model done is not task PASS. All original multibranch/formal gates remain closed until their actual prerequisites pass.
trace_requirements: Raw proposals, observations, original grade, patch bytes, raw/distinct/physical/rejected actions, exact and canonical failed re-executions, successful inspection repeats, actual grounded commits and next-input facts, quote validation errors, model plan/interpretation, observed edit/test/done behavior, context drop/dedup counts, native prefill/decode/concurrency/eviction and wall cost. Report if the model elects not to cite evidence. Verify a committed excerpt is visible in actual subsequent token IDs, not only a JSON summary.
interpretation: Evidence persistence passing with continued loops isolates a remaining agent-policy/coding limitation under this model and budget; it does not prove universal incapability. If no useful evidence is cited, the model has not exercised the full intervention. No outcome-driven wording/schema/budget sweep follows this closed recipe.
authorization_context: User-renewed autonomous same-task repair with reasonable method changes, grounded in the observed serial solver's missing task-semantic integration. Earlier model episodes and LoRA recipe remain closed.
stop: One terminal official episode or concrete infrastructure/budget blocker; no repeat for a negative quality outcome. Release owned compute and actual task containers, retain closed artifacts. Parent objective is not complete at this phase.
